findings.current: Having lost control of the conversation in an instant, he could only leave with his face rigid as a rock, following Jeong Hogun.
findings.defect: Jeong Hogun appears to follow himself; Ma Sanbao is the one leading him away.
findings.rationale: The preceding exchange establishes that Ma Sanbao has seized the initiative and Jeong Hogun is reluctantly going with him.
findings.replacement: Having lost control of the conversation in an instant, Jeong Hogun could only follow Ma Sanbao, his face rigid as a rock.
findings.source: Chapter 890, Ma Sanbao and Jeong Hogun leaving the guard post

findings.current: And so the greatest assassin of all time became the Divine Physician.
findings.defect: This makes the Slaughter Saint and his disciple, the Divine Physician, the same person.
findings.rationale: The surrounding passage identifies the former assassin as the Divine Physician’s Master.
findings.replacement: And so the greatest assassin of all time became a physician.
findings.source: Chapter 893, Jin reflecting on the Slaughter Saint

findings.current: Are you certain the old man you saw was the One-Legged Killing Ghost?
findings.defect: The epithet differs from the packet’s established “One-Legged Ghost Killer.”
findings.rationale: The translation decision explicitly maps both variants of the epithet to “One-Legged Ghost Killer.”
findings.replacement: Are you certain the old man you saw was the One-Legged Ghost Killer?
findings.source: Chapter 893, Namho’s question about the old assassin

findings.current: According to the information the Hidden Shadow Pavilion obtained, the One-Legged Killing Ghost had only one leg.
findings.defect: The same assassin’s epithet changes again within the conversation.
findings.rationale: Keeping the established epithet makes clear that Namho is discussing the person Sama Pyo just named.
findings.replacement: According to the information the Hidden Shadow Pavilion obtained, the One-Legged Ghost Killer had only one leg.
findings.source: Chapter 893, Namho describing the assassin’s prosthetic leg

summary: The packet is largely consistent, but one action is assigned to the wrong person, one title creates a character contradiction, and the assassin’s epithet drifts twice.
